submission.hostingReason: The product is a browser application that converts reading files rather than firmware installed on the ESP32-S3. It produces XTC documents, so there is no device firmware .bin to submit. The maintained converter runs on xtcjs.app.
submission.userFlow: Install CrossPoint Reader on Sticky, open xtcjs.app, select Sticky as the target device, choose a local CBZ/CBR or PDF, adjust and preview the conversion, download the XTC file, transfer it to the reader, and read the converted pages on Sticky.
